'''Scott Valentine''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Bravo 25 from Burke, Va. At DecipherCon 1999 he finished 2nd in the [[Young Jedi]] event YJ Opposites.<ref name="dc99yj20_5">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ20_5.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Opposites], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010108191900/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ20_5.html Internet Archive]</ref>
